Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class SomeGooglyGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.SomeGooglyGameTestsLogic
public final class SomeGooglyGameTestsLogic extends Object
Core integration checks for loaded cow geometry, spawn-time eye-state initialization, entity appearance overrides, the Googly Eye item's portable appearance payload, and death harvesting.

  • Method Details

    • configuredCowHasServerGeometry

      public static void configuredCowHasServerGeometry(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The bundled cow definition resolves to real eye geometry on the server. In game: set entityOverrides = ["minecraft:cow,100"] and spawn a cow; it has eyes on its head.

    • spawnInitializesEyePersistentData

      public static void spawnInitializesEyePersistentData(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A spawning mob gets its eye decision and placement roll at once. In game, on NeoForge or Forge: spawn a cow and run /data get entity <cow>; its NeoForgeData or ForgeData holds somegoogly:hasGooglyEyes and a somegoogly:eyeVariantRoll between 0 and 1.

    • entityPersistentDataSurvivesSaveLoad

      public static void entityPersistentDataSurvivesSaveLoad(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, String loader)
      Eye state survives an entity save and load through the loader's own persistent-data store. In game: give a mob eyes and an iris tint with /sg admin, save and quit, reopen the world, and the mob still shows the same eyes in the same color.

    • conversionKeepsEyeState

      public static void conversionKeepsEyeState(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A mob Minecraft converts into another keeps its eye state. In game: give a mooshroom eyes and an iris tint with /sg admin, then shear it; the cow it becomes shows the same eyes in the same color.

    • eyeStateAppearanceOverridesRoundTrip

      public static void eyeStateAppearanceOverridesRoundTrip(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A mob's iris, cornea, and glow overrides read back as set. In game: on an eyed cow, run /sg admin tint iris 0.25 0.5 0.75, /sg admin tint cornea 0.9 0.8 0.7, and /sg admin glow on; its eyes show both colors and glow.

    • googlyEyeItemStoresAppearanceOverride

      public static void googlyEyeItemStoresAppearanceOverride(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A Googly Eye stack carries its appearance. In game: harvest an eye from a cow given an iris, cornea, and glow with /sg admin; the dropped eye's tooltip lists all three.

    • optometristAcceptsOnlyShears

      public static void optometristAcceptsOnlyShears(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Optometrist goes only on shears and is treasure-only. In game: in an anvil, an Optometrist book combines with shears but not with a pickaxe, and the enchantment never appears in an enchanting table.

    • deathHarvestUsesTheSuppliedDropSink

      public static void deathHarvestUsesTheSuppliedDropSink(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      A shears kill can drop one Googly Eye carrying the mob's look. In game: set harvestOnKillPercent = 100, tint an eyed cow's iris with /sg admin tint iris 0.2 0.4 0.6, and kill it in survival with melee blows from shears; one Googly Eye with that iris color drops with the cow's loot, and the shears lose one durability for the harvest.

    • deathHarvestRejectsNonqualifyingKills

      public static void deathHarvestRejectsNonqualifyingKills(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Only a qualifying kill harvests. In game, with harvestOnKillPercent = 100: no Googly Eye drops when an eyed cow is killed with a sword, an eyeless cow with shears, an eyed cow by something other than a player, or an eyed cow with shears while harvestOnKillPercent = 0 or googlyEyesEnabled = false.
